title: feat: warn if same attribute is used for different faceting type
body:
**Summary**

### [FX-2231](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-2231)

**Result**

Added warnings in each connector that adds facets to search parameters if the same attribute is used for a different kind of facet, in which case the search parameters will not be mutated.
If we have a `Menu` and `RefinementList` using the same attribute, currently none of them would be displayed as they would have no facets to choose from. With these changes, only the first one will work and a warning for the second one will be displayed.

I guess this could have been handled directly by the helper, but doing it in InstantSearch makes it so that we can tell which connector has this problem, allowing users to debug more easily.
